title: Security posture overview
description: Local Defender, firewall, TPM, BitLocker, Secure Boot; creates a private report.

title: Repair & change history
description: Shows actions selected using this toolkit. An invocation is not proof of repair success.

title: Save baseline snapshot
description: Stores selected OS/driver/RAM/firmware facts for later comparison.

title: Compare two snapshots
description: Highlights changed drivers, memory and firmware; select two saved snapshots.

title: Folder backup comparison
description: Compare two local folders by path/size, optionally SHA-256 hashes; no changes.

title: Package + driver update scan
description: Use V3 combined report: installed drivers + WinGet app updates only.

title: Startup & heavy RAM report
description: App memory working sets and startup registrations; no termination.

title: Security check in console
description: Quick Defender/firewall/encryption status; does not make changes.

title: System reliability events
description: Critical/error System & Application events from the last 48 hours.

title: Check restore point status
description: Inspect shadow-copy/restore support; no restore point created.

title: Preview Gaming profile
description: See proposed power profile and settings pages, no changes.

title: Apply Gaming profile
description: Use existing High Performance plan if installed and open Game Mode/settings. Undo supported.

title: Preview Programming profile
description: See proposed power mode and developer settings, no changes.

title: Apply Programming profile
description: Select Balanced plan if available; open Developer & Startup Settings. Undo supported.

title: Preview Studying profile
description: See study-friendly settings and changes before applying.

title: Apply Studying profile
description: Select Balanced plan; open Notifications/Display. Never disables notifications automatically.

title: Preview Battery Saver profile
description: Use installed power saver plan if available; show battery settings.

title: Apply Battery Saver profile
description: Choose existing Power Saver plan if present; Undo supported.

title: Restore pre-profile power plan
description: Restore original saved power plan before this toolkit changed it.

title: Show current plan/profile
description: Read current Windows power plan and any toolkit backup.

title: Curated app installer menu
description: Optional single-app WinGet install. Shows package details before YES. Never installs all.

title: Developer environment doctor
description: Report Python, pip, Node, .NET, Git, Visual Studio, CMake and Ninja.

title: Windows installed apps/repair UI
description: Opens app controls; you choose Repair/Modify for an individual app.

title: App upgrades scan (WinGet)
description: Find supported app updates. Does not install apps or drivers.

title: Official Windows driver offers
description: Opens Optional updates; checks offered compatible drivers only.

title: Find tool executable paths
description: Inspect locations for powershell, python, git, node and winget.

title: Check signed download file
description: Read Authenticode status and SHA256 hash for a selected file.

title: Symptom-guided troubleshooting
description: Choose a problem for focused read-only checks and optional repair recommendations.

title: Open All Tasks (God Mode)
description: Open Windows All Tasks shell folder, no system changes.

title: Open hidden shell folders
description: Choose AppsFolder, SendTo, Startup, Recycle Bin or Downloads.

title: Hidden Run shortcuts
description: Show useful Win+R tools such as perfmon /rel, dxdiag and joy.cpl.

title: Windows keyboard tricks
description: Emoji, clipboard, snip, GPU refresh and virtual-desktop shortcuts.

title: Fun Matrix-style terminal rain
description: Harmless terminal animation lasting a few seconds; no filesystem/network action.

title: Random Windows tip
description: Fun short tip from built-in Windows functions.

title: Advanced boot entry view
description: Read BCD firmware entries only; do not delete old boot entries.

title: Advanced services insight
description: Read service details, no stopping/reconfiguration.

title: Advanced task triggers
description: Read scheduled tasks matching optional search term; no modifications.

title: Advanced network routes
description: Read routing and network interface diagnostics.

title: Windows performance tools
description: Open Resource, Performance and Reliability Monitor.

title: Taskbar/Explorer recovery
description: Restart Explorer and taskbar on confirmation.

title: View integrated repair kit
description: Open the integrated 51-action diagnostic/repair menu.

title: RAM usage delta (10 seconds)
description: Samples working sets twice and prints changes without terminating processes.

title: Save driver inventory CSV
description: Read drivers to file without updating or replacing hardware drivers.

title: Open Windows Store
description: Browse Store apps independently from WinGet; no auto install.

title: Unsigned driver inventory
description: Reports drivers marked unsigned; this is not automatically malware.
